name: Gakuen no Succubus-san
original_name: 学園のサキュバスさん
source:
A succubus woman comes to an academy as the principal.
The one with the best sexual desire and organ she demands is a janitor man.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ224021.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]

一名魅魔来到学园担任校长。
而最符合她要求、拥有最旺盛性欲与最出众性器官的人，竟是一名男勤杂工。
